info.name: Curio
info.summary: Curate images, links, videos and notes into visual boards, right inside Nextcloud.
info.description:
Curio turns the images, links, videos and notes you collect into visual boards you can filter, tag and share. Paste a link from Pinterest, Instagram, YouTube or any website and it pulls in the picture, title and a snapshot for you. Upload your own photos, drop in a PDF, or jot a quick note.
## Bring everything together
Add references from wherever you find them:
- Photos and images uploaded straight from your device - Links from Pinterest, Instagram, YouTube and any website, with the image, title and a saved snapshot grabbed automatically - Videos, either embedded from a provider or uploaded directly - PDFs, shown with a page preview - Plain text notes for the ideas that do not have a link yet
Hashtags are recognized and are suggested and the ones you already have are automatically added, but you can easily remove those you don't want during the reference import.
When a page offers more than one image, you choose which one becomes the tile.
## Organize the way you think
Sort references into boards, one per project, mood or topic. Tag them with colored labels and group those labels into folders, so a growing collection stays easy to navigate.
Switch between layouts and filter by file type, boards and/or tags to view your references however you like.
## Collaborate
Share a board with anyone on your Nextcloud, with view-only or full edit access. Sharing uses Nextcloud's own sharing and permissions, so collaborators' changes are attributed to them. Leave comments on a reference to discuss it in context.
## How files are handled
- On first launch you choose the Nextcloud folder where Curio keeps its boards. Your references can be found in that folder and subfolders and removal of curio will not delete them. - Files can be dropped into those folders from the nextcloud file manager and they will appear on the board. Renaming or removing from outside the app also works. - Imported images will be converted to .webp to save up on space on your cloud. - Videos are not converted and will be links to the site so they may break if site removes the videos or moves them - A button in the settings lets you export or import a board as CSV of references. - Everything remains on your server, nothing is sent to a third party. Your references live on your server, under your control.
